title: Add coordinator-authoritative network worker policy
summary: Implement Phase E from the network worker hardening plan so the coordinator ships hardware-neutral per-library processing policy and workers supply only hardware-specific encoder mapping.
reason: Network workers currently decide processing policy from their own full config, which can diverge from coordinator library policy and produce inconsistent outputs across machines.
behavior_before: Network claims carried an encode_config snapshot that did not represent coordinator-authoritative per-library policy, and worker launch used the worker's own full config for non-hardware media settings.
behavior_after: Coordinator claims carry a versioned hardware-neutral policy; workers can map codec family and quality tier to local hardware encoders under a guarded WorkerHonorCoordinatorPolicy path; UI/docs surface policy authority and policy-divergence review evidence. WorkerHonorCoordinatorPolicy remains default OFF until representative real-media validation is complete.
